name: Stanley Arkwright

poster.epithet: the man in the good coat
poster.hook: Says he got off the last train. The register says no one did.

flashback: What do you remember about the train you got off, and what don't you want to remember?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Stanley is already in the waiting room when the first players arrive, polite and dry-coated. He's a question the table can keep asking. Don't answer it.

story.concept: A soft-spoken insurance man in a good camel coat that's somehow dry. He says he stepped off the 6:10 on the second night. He's certain of it. He's less certain of other things.
story.look: Camel coat, polished brogues without a speck of moor on them, a trilby he holds in both hands, a smell of coal smoke that follows him.
carrying: a photograph of a woman on a beach
story.stake: He has to get back on that train. He can't say why, only that someone's waiting at the other end.

ties.text: She watches him like he's a signal she can't read. He'd like to tell her the truth, if he knew what it was.
He's seen his own name on an envelope in her sack. He hasn't asked. He's afraid of what the address will be.
